column1: # Lamakan Desert: Mia's other self takes over after the Manticore falls.

column3: That's all it had? It was\nbarely awake. Honestly,\nI'm a little insulted.{end_wait}
Mia, that thing was one of\nthe awakened. You enjoyed\nkilling it.{end_wait}
Of course I did. They all\nend up the same way, so\nknow your place, Garet.{end_wait}
Wait... did I say that?\nI don't remember drawing\nthe blade.{end_wait}
That voice again. Mia, the\nblade is choosing for you,\nand we need to talk.{end_wait}
